entries.name: Initiative
entries.notes: Core Initiative rolls, Invisible Advantage, and Surprise Disadvantage are implemented; full condition-driven Initiative modifiers and RAW tie adjudication are not.
sources: D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Playing the Game — Combat — Initiative

entries.name: Surprise
entries.notes: Surprise imposes Disadvantage on Initiative; the engine does not invent a surprise round or free pre-Initiative attack.
sources: D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Rules Glossary — Surprise
D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Playing the Game — Combat — Initiative

entries.name: Pre-combat Hide
entries.notes: Eligible scenario actors can attempt Hide before Initiative without spending their first combat Action or Bonus Action; failure does not create Surprise.
sources: D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Rules Glossary — Hide [Action]
D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Playing the Game — Combat — Initiative

entries.name: Rogue ambush demo
entries.notes: The scenario supplies valid concealment and an unaware target; the Hide check still determines whether the hidden opening and Surprise are earned.
sources: D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Rules Glossary — Hide [Action]
D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Rules Glossary — Surprise
D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Character Classes — Rogue — Level 1: Sneak Attack

entries.name: Rogue Sneak Attack
entries.notes: Advantage route, Finesse/Ranged gating, once-per-turn timing including reaction turns, critical dice, and weapon damage type are implemented; the ally-within-5-feet route awaits ally-position context.
sources: D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Character Classes — Rogue — Level 1: Sneak Attack

entries.name: Weapon attack rolls
entries.notes: Base AC resolution, natural 1 misses, natural 20 hits, and supported attack modifiers are implemented.
sources: D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Playing the Game — Combat — Making an Attack

entries.name: Weapon critical hits
entries.notes: Natural-20 attack criticals double the attack's eligible damage dice, including Sneak Attack and conditional attack damage, while modifiers are not doubled.
sources: D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Playing the Game — Damage and Healing — Critical Hits

entries.name: Advantage and Disadvantage
entries.notes: Multiple Advantage or Disadvantage sources do not stack, and any amount of both cancels to a normal d20 roll.
sources: D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Rules Glossary — Advantage / Disadvantage

entries.name: Weapon range
entries.notes: Melee reach, normal/long range, and the sight-dependent close-ranged penalty are implemented for current visibility states; the Incapacitated close-enemy exception and special-sense visibility are not yet modeled.
sources: D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Playing the Game — Combat — Ranged Attacks in Close Combat; Equipment — Weapon Range
D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Rules Glossary — Invisible [Condition]

entries.name: Arena movement
entries.notes: The arena tracks one-dimensional distance, Speed, closing, retreating, and remaining movement; it is not a general grid/terrain movement implementation.
sources: D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Playing the Game — Combat — Movement and Position
Iron Pit arena contract — explicit non-SRD assumption

entries.name: Dash
entries.notes: Dash spends the Action and grants extra movement equal to Speed within the current movement model.
sources: D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Rules Glossary — Dash [Action]
D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Playing the Game — Combat — Movement and Position

entries.name: 0 HP arena defeat
entries.notes: Damage and healing are tracked, but the duel treats 0 HP as defeat instead of running the full player-character death/unconsciousness rules.
sources: D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Playing the Game — Damage and Healing — Dropping to 0 Hit Points
D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Playing the Game — Damage and Healing — Death Saving Throws
Iron Pit arena contract — explicit non-SRD assumption

entries.name: Fighter Second Wind
entries.notes: Bonus Action use, two level-1 uses, 1d10 + Fighter level healing, and the max-HP cap are implemented; Short/Long Rest recharge is not yet modeled.
sources: D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Character Classes — Fighter — Level 1: Second Wind

entries.name: Light weapon extra attack
entries.notes: A Light-weapon Attack-action attack can enable one extra attack with a different Light weapon; Bonus Action cost, once-per-turn use, and ability-modifier damage restrictions are implemented.
sources: D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Equipment — Weapon Properties — Light

entries.name: Two-Weapon Fighting style
entries.notes: The Fighting Style restores the ability modifier to damage for the Light-property extra attack.
sources: D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Feats — Fighting Style Feats — Two-Weapon Fighting
D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Equipment — Weapon Properties — Light

entries.name: Nick mastery
entries.notes: A mastered Nick weapon can move the one Light-property extra attack into the Attack action instead of spending the Bonus Action; it does not create another Light attack.
sources: D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Equipment — Mastery Properties — Nick
D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Equipment — Weapon Properties — Light

entries.name: Sap mastery
entries.notes: A mastered Sap weapon imposes Disadvantage on the target's next attack roll before the start of the wielder's next turn.
sources: D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Equipment — Mastery Properties — Sap

entries.name: Vex mastery
entries.notes: A mastered Vex weapon that deals damage grants target-specific Advantage on the wielder's next attack against that creature before the end of the wielder's next turn.
sources: D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Equipment — Mastery Properties — Vex

entries.name: Goblin Advantage damage
entries.notes: The Goblin Warrior's extra 1d4 damage applies only when that attack roll actually had Advantage.
sources: D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Creature Stat Blocks — Goblin Warrior

entries.name: Opportunity Attacks
entries.notes: Reaction timing, pre-movement resolution, reach exit, Disengage suppression, and current sight checks are implemented; Incapacitated and special-sense visibility interactions are not yet complete.
sources: D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Rules Glossary — Opportunity Attack
D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Rules Glossary — Disengage [Action]
D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Rules Glossary — Invisible [Condition]

entries.name: Disengage
entries.notes: Disengage prevents Opportunity Attacks caused by the creature's movement for the rest of that turn in the supported movement path.
sources: D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Rules Glossary — Disengage [Action]
D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Rules Glossary — Opportunity Attack

entries.name: Reactions
entries.notes: Reaction availability and Opportunity Attacks are implemented; the broader Reaction rule space is not.
sources: D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Rules Glossary — Reaction
D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Rules Glossary — Opportunity Attack

entries.name: Goblin Nimble Escape
entries.notes: Bonus Action Disengage and Hide are both wired; the Hide option inherits the partial Hide/Invisible visibility boundary.
sources: D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Creature Stat Blocks — Goblin Warrior — Nimble Escape
D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Rules Glossary — Hide [Action]
D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Rules Glossary — Disengage [Action]

entries.name: Hide
entries.notes: DC 15 Stealth, supported concealment/line-of-sight eligibility, stored discovery DC, Search discovery, attack-roll reveal, and pre-combat Hide are implemented; noise, Verbal-spell, and broader visibility/sense interactions remain incomplete.
sources: D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Rules Glossary — Hide [Action]
D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Rules Glossary — Invisible [Condition]

entries.name: Search for hidden creatures
entries.notes: Wisdom (Perception) can use the Search action against a hidden creature's recorded Hide DC in the supported stealth model.
sources: D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Rules Glossary — Search [Action]
D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Rules Glossary — Hide [Action]

entries.name: Invisible condition
entries.notes: Initiative Advantage, concealed-state attack Advantage/Disadvantage, and supported sight checks are implemented; special senses and all seen-target effect restrictions are not.
sources: D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Rules Glossary — Invisible [Condition]

entries.name: Conditions
entries.notes: Only the supported Invisible subset is represented; the general condition framework is incomplete.
sources: D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Playing the Game — Conditions; Rules Glossary
D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Rules Glossary — Invisible [Condition]

entries.name: Cover
entries.notes: Cover categories are represented for Hide eligibility; AC bonuses, Dexterity-save bonuses, and full line-of-effect behavior are not implemented.
sources: D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Playing the Game — Combat — Cover
D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Rules Glossary — Hide [Action]

entries.name: Spells
entries.notes: Spellcasting is outside the current duel slice.
sources: D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Spells — Casting Spells

entries.name: Death Saving Throws
entries.notes: Death Saving Throws and the complete 0-HP player-character flow are not implemented.
sources: D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Playing the Game — Damage and Healing — Death Saving Throws

entries.name: Initiative ties
entries.notes: The arena currently uses Initiative bonus as a deterministic tiebreaker instead of the RAW player/DM tie decision process.
sources: D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Playing the Game — Combat — Initiative
Iron Pit arena contract — explicit non-SRD assumption

entries.name: Arena geometry
entries.notes: Combat uses one-dimensional distance with open-arena visibility by default and explicit per-actor concealment overrides.
sources: D&D Beyond Basic Rules (2024): Playing the Game — Combat — Movement and Position
Iron Pit arena contract — explicit non-SRD assumption
